en:
## New Features

- Show background task activity on narrator sidebar and list with count badges and half-filled status icons.
- Open panels and workspaces in independent windows with PWA title bar support, safer fallbacks, and faster Git first paint.
- Show a global header banner when maintenance freeze is active; admins can cancel preparation and resume work directly.
- Complete the async question loop so questions stay clearly attributed after compact, fork, and session recovery.

## Bug Fixes

- Request snapshots no longer permanently drop history classification stats.
- Header and settings page now share the same maintenance readiness state.
- Panel independent windows correctly consume route-decoded descriptors.
- Floating overlays above the WCO drag region no longer turn clicks into window drags.
- Align the status bar background task button height with adjacent labels.
- Support bounded reflection retries and distinguish check failures from content rejections.
- More accurate context usage accounting and faster character statistics rebuilds.
- Preserve Windows session path casing when creating and inheriting narrators.

## Performance Improvements

- Reduce scroll blocking in large message lists by deferring interaction setup and reusing layout results.
- Reuse fixed tool time labels to cut repeated formatting cost.

## Other Changes

- Collapse PostgreSQL migration snapshots into a single baseline while keeping full SQL and journal history.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 叙述者侧栏与列表展现后台任务活跃状态，含计数角标与半填状态图标。
- 面板与工作区支持独立窗口，提供 PWA 标题栏、安全回退与更快的 Git 首屏。
- 全局页头提示维护暂停状态，管理员可直接取消准备并恢复工作。
- 完整实现异步提问闭环，问题在压缩、Fork 与会话恢复后仍保持明确归属。

## 修复

- 请求快照不再永久丢失历史分类统计。
- 顶部与设置页共用同一维护准备状态。
- 面板独立窗口正确消费路由解码后的描述符。
- WCO 拖拽区上方的浮动层不再把点击吞成窗口拖拽。
- 对齐状态栏后台任务按钮与相邻文案高度。
- 支持有界反思纠错，并区分检查故障与内容否决。
- 统一上下文占用口径，并加快字符统计重建。
- 保留 Windows 会话路径大小写。

## 性能优化

- 降低大幅滚动的同步布局阻塞，并延后交互初始化。
- 复用工具时间标签，减少重复格式化开销。

## 其他变更

- 将 PostgreSQL 迁移快照收敛为单一基线，同时保留完整 SQL 与 journal 历史。
